# Brumascara

**Status: DRAFT** · world: [rogue](../lore/worlds/rogue.md) · kind: new · stage: space · id: `brumascara`

## Niche

- **Habitat:** 0.5-3 km altitude, under ice canopy, in thermal plumes
- **Diet:** Filter-feeds airborne microbes, dissolves radiolytic peroxides
- **Active:** Soaring on convection currents
- **Predators:** none

## Body

Buoyant gas bladder, thin membranous wings, streamlined neck

**Temperament:** Curious, migratory, drawn to warm air
